usage.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-heading font-bold text-gray-900 mb-6
usage.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-heading font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4
usage.caption: text-sm text-gray-500

new_to_create.name: BlogCard
new_to_create.description: Card component for displaying blog post summaries in the list view. Includes image, category badge, title, excerpt, and read more link.

new_to_create.name: BlogSidebar
new_to_create.description: Sidebar for single post view containing 'About Agent', 'Categories', and 'Recent Posts'.

new_to_create.name: AdminPostEditor
new_to_create.description: Form for creating/editing blog posts. Includes title, slug, category, content (textarea or rich text), and image URL input.

new_to_create.name: SEOHead
new_to_create.description: Component to manage document head (title, meta description, OG tags, JSON-LD) using react-helmet or similar.

blog_list.structure: Header > Hero (Title + Search) > FilterBar (Categories) > Grid(BlogCards) > Pagination > Footer

blog_post.structure: Header > Breadcrumb > Article(HeroImage + Title + Meta + Content) + Sidebar > RelatedPosts > Footer

admin_dashboard.structure: SidebarNav > PostListTable (with Actions: Edit, Delete) > CreateButton

ui_assets.hero_bg: Use existing hero background or one of the house images with overlay
ui_assets.agent_placeholder: Use existing agent photo if available, otherwise generic professional avatar

seo_requirements.sitemap: Dynamic generation of /sitemap.xml including all blog posts

admin_requirements.auth: Simple password protection (mock or basic auth)

universal_guidelines.design_philosophy: Clean, trustworthy, and local. Use white space generously. Blue (#0079e8) is for actions and primary highlights only.
universal_guidelines.interaction: Hover effects on cards (lift up + shadow). Smooth transitions for all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure sufficient contrast for text. Use semantic HTML (article, section, aside, nav).
universal_guidelines.responsive: Mobile-first approach. Stack grids on mobile, expand on tablet/desktop.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Create the blog pages and components following the structure above. 2. Implement the admin interface with simple state management (Context or local storage for MVP). 3. Ensure SEO components are reusable. 4. Use the provided image URLs for the 3 placeholder articles. 5. Maintain the existing header/footer from the landing page.
